description:
Solve web CAPTCHA challenges (Turnstile, hCaptcha, reCAPTCHA v2, Arkose, Cloudflare) and return a valid solution token. Automatically retries once on failure without double charging. Requires x402 payment on Base.

When to use: Use when an agent encounters a bot wall or CAPTCHA challenge during automated web workflows.
When NOT to use: Do NOT use for non-CAPTCHA auth, 2FA/OTP codes, or general login forms.

Parameters:
- `type` (string, required): CAPTCHA type ('turnstile', 'hcaptcha', 'recaptcha', 'arkose', 'cloudflare').
- `sitekey` (string, required): Public sitekey extracted from the target page DOM.
- `url` (string, required): Full target webpage URL hosting the challenge.

sitekey.description: The CAPTCHA sitekey parameter extracted from the target page DOM or iframe.

type.description: The specific type of CAPTCHA challenge encountered on the target page.

url.description: The full target page URL where the CAPTCHA challenge is hosted.

name: solve_captcha

elapsed.description: Time taken in seconds to solve the challenge

method.description: Solving method or backend engine used

solved.description: Whether the CAPTCHA challenge was successfully solved

token.description: The resulting CAPTCHA response token to submit to the form
